about_the_game:
Tower of Hanoi can be considered one of the oldest, simplest, and most complex intellectual games and mathematical puzzles. The goal of the game is to move all the plates from one of the three pillars to another, with only two restrictions: only one plate can be moved at a time, and large plates cannot be placed on top of small plates. In the legends of ancient civilizations, the gods promised that if the transfer of the 64 story Tower of Hanoi was completed, the current world would come to an end, perhaps everything would become better?

Compared to existing computer works by the Tower of Hanoi, this work has features:

  • In addition to the classic opening, a random opening has been added, allowing each game to be brand new;

  • Provide automatic movement mode and switch between manual and automatic movement at any time and in any state;

  • It provides all the different difficulty levels of starting from the 1st level plate to the 64th level plate. In fact, according to calculations, the transfer of the 64th level plate takes hundreds of billions of years, and no one can complete it. However, it is still worth trying. What if the ending of the world can be summoned?

  • As the game progresses, the stars in the sky will light up and eventually transform into unknown elf.
